briefing.headline: AMD slides 2.1% as tech mega‑caps retreat
briefing.summary: The overnight session saw most of the core US equity tokens pull back, with all ten large‑cap tech names posting declines of 1‑2% and the SPY and QQQ ETFs also slipping. Only a handful of niche or leveraged tokens bucked the trend, led by SKDD up 12% and SOXS up 6.5%. Breadth was thin, nine decliners versus one advancer, pointing to a risk‑off tone ahead of the US open. Traders should watch for any fresh macro data that could shift sentiment.
